Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection

Interface ClaimProtectionProvider

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ClaimProtectionProvider
Extension point for claim systems that authorize Some Buckets interactions before mutation. Providers are composed by unanimous consent: returning false vetoes the action and prevents later providers and the mod-owned mutation from running.

  • Method Details

    • mayAct

      boolean mayAct(net.minecraft.server.level.ServerLevel level, ProtectionContext context, ProtectionAction action, net.minecraft.core.BlockPos target, net.minecraft.core.Direction face, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, @Nullable net.minecraft.world.entity.Entity targetEntity)
      Decides whether one exact action may proceed.

      For fluid-edit, block-edit, and block-interaction actions, target is the block that will be changed or interacted with and face is the contacted or placement face supplied to that operation. For entity interaction, target is the entity's block position and face is the interaction direction chosen by the caller. For entity release, target is the destination and face is the release direction.

      Parameters:
      level - server level in which the action applies
      context - acting player and hand, dispenser source, or explicit unowned automation
      action - kind of mutation or interaction being authorized
      target - exact block position associated with the action
      face - non-null face or direction associated with the action
      stack - bucket stack driving the action
      targetEntity - entity being interacted with or released, including an unspawned probe; null when the action has no entity target
      Returns:
      true to allow evaluation to continue, or false to veto the action
